description: This file implements the core logic for executing user actions in the Playwright recorder, including navigation, clicking, filling forms, and assertions, utilizing various utility functions and classes.

methods.name: performAction
methods.description: Executes a specified user action within a given page context, handling different action types like navigation, click, fill, and assertions.

methods.name: performActionImpl
methods.description: Internal implementation that performs the specific action based on its type, utilizing the mainFrame object.

methods.name: toClickOptions
methods.description: Converts a click action into mouse click options, including button, modifiers, click count, and position.
